{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of the 'channel' column
channel_counts = sales_df['channel'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of 'revenue' by channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Ensure there are exactly three channels
unique_channels = sales_df['channel'].unique()

channel_counts, revenue_by_channel, unique_channels"}
